_references: Bazavov et al. (2016) Phys Rev D 93, 014512
Bazavov et al. (2012) Phys Rev D 86, 034509

_provenance.data_origin: Freeze-out curve T_f(mu_B) = T0*(1 - kappa2*(mu_B/T0)^2) with Gaussian noise
_provenance.real_data_accession: N/A (analytical freeze-out curve with synthetic noise)

_description: Chi-squared fitting inverse problem: recover freeze-out curve parameters from noisy observables using grid search. Validates polynomial forward model, chi-squared statistic, 2D grid search recovery, and noise degradation.
_groundspring_question: Can grid-search chi-squared fitting recover known parameters from noisy polynomial observables at subpercent precision?

expected_results.noise_degradation_slack_rationale: Low-noise recovery is expected to be better, but grid discretization (step=0.25 MeV, 0.0001 kappa2) can create ties. 0.5 absorbs grid-step aliasing.
